02 / A signature story

A house that
gave back.

The 2009 Atlanta Holiday House gathered design, craft and community under one roof.

Set in Buckhead, the show home brought together 13 Atlanta interior designers for public tours that supported local charities. Steven designed and built the home and coordinated the designers.

The home earned OBIE recognition. The exact award category and year are [TO CONFIRM] because the current website lists conflicting details. The house remains a vivid example of Steven's belief that a home can be both personal and purposeful.

03 / The person behind the work

An artist's eye.
A builder's presence.

For Steven West, a home is more than a set of plans. It is a work shaped by the people who will live in it.

Steven studied art before finding his calling in homebuilding. He works alongside clients through design and finish selections, then stays close to the build with a daily presence on site.

07 / Good to know

Questions before
we begin.

These answers are working copy and should be reviewed with Steven before public launch.

Can you build on a lot I already own?

Bring the address and any surveys or site information to your consultation. Steven can discuss how the lot may affect the design, scope and next steps. [CONFIRM WITH CLIENT]

How long does a custom home take?

Timing depends on design, approvals, site conditions and the home itself. Steven can outline a project-specific schedule once the scope is clearer. [CONFIRM WITH CLIENT]

Can I make changes during construction?

Changes may be possible, but they can affect cost and schedule. The team should document each change and its impact before work proceeds. [CONFIRM WITH CLIENT]

What warranty is included?

Warranty coverage and service terms will be explained in the construction agreement. Ask Steven for the current written details. [CONFIRM WITH CLIENT]

What areas do you serve?

Steven West Custom Homes is based in the Atlanta area. The exact service boundary depends on project scope and location. [CONFIRM WITH CLIENT]

What happens during the free consultation?

You can share your goals, lot status, budget range and ideal timing. Steven will discuss fit and practical next steps for your project. [CONFIRM WITH CLIENT]
